title: feat(master-detail): de-frame line items, compact lookup cells, persist line order
body:
## Why

You flagged that the subform editor "外面套了一个框，浪费了很多空间" — the line items were wrapped in a `Card` (border + `p-6`) around a grid that already has its own border, double-framing it and stealing the width the table needs. Plus the three wrap-up items.

## What

- **De-frame the line-item section** — render it as a light label + the grid's own bordered table (no outer Card / `p-6`), so it spans the full content width.
- **Compact lookup cells** — `LookupField` gains a `compact` mode (used by grid lookup cells): the selected value shows inline in a borderless single-line trigger, instead of a chip stacked above a separate "Select…" button (which doubled the row height).
- **Persist drag-reorder** — `deriveMasterDetail` detects a sort field (`position`/`sort_order`/…), excludes it from the editable columns + row form, and threads it as the grid's `sort_field`, so reordering stamps `row[position] = index` and survives a reload.
- **Fix the long-standing flaky `ListView` unit test** — with no filters the empty state is the first-run copy ("Nothing here yet"), not "No items found". CI Test job goes green (no more admin-merges needed for this).

## Verification

- Unit: 63 across GridField / deriveMasterDetail / masterDetailTx / MasterDetailForm; ListView suite 119 green.
- Live e2e: 9 passing — New Invoice asserts the compact lookup auto-fill, computed amount, totals stack, and the stamped `position`.
- Browser-verified: single-frame full-width grid + single-line product cell.

> Pairs with framework#1641 (`showcase_invoice_line.position`).
